subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: If If a hosted lock approval is attempted by an agent identity, Argus included, or a local lock lacks a valid FR-52 receipt, then the system shall refuse the lock and request the required operator approval evidence
intent: the refusal naming the missing or invalid evidence and, for local mode, its unauthenticated-actor limit
fit_criterion: Every hosted agent-approval fixture and every invalid local receipt fixture refuses without advancing landing refs; no fixture claims that a consistent local receipt proves human authorship
